systems.owner: Ministère des Enseignements Maternel et Primaire; the notice is from its Directeur des Examens et Concours
systems.tiers: primary schools hold accounts and look up a candidate by matricule or table number; parents hold accounts, with log-in details issued by the child's school

note: The notice of 3 August 2026 says only that CEP 2026 transcripts can be downloaded from the platform by schools and parents; that is examination results, and it does not say schools enter learner records, so on this document alone the platform is single-function and gives no fact. It does show a matricule per learner and parent accounts tied to a child.
